boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Read every mandatory skill and directly required reference completely in its own bounded command before task actions, then run discovery separately.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never infer a complete instruction read from a timed-out batch; preserve the timeout and obtain one end-to-end witness per mandatory file.
preferred_methods.rollback: Discard only the incomplete batch result, retain its negative, and reread each authoritative instruction source directly.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Instruction-read reliability only; not authority, identity continuity, or validation evidence.
preferred_methods.title: Standalone complete reads for mandatory skills and references

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Treat exit 1 as a no-match result, inspect the current exact-head task group in the registry, and read only the newest directly relevant same-day note.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: A no-match query cannot establish absence; use the newest indexed task group and bounded ad-hoc note before stopping.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the no-match receipt and avoid broad rollout scans unless the bounded fallback remains insufficient.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Memory retrieval ergonomics only; memory claims remain subordinate to live repository verification.
preferred_methods.title: Newest-task-group and same-day-note memory fallback

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Run fetch, local anchor ancestry, live-remote equality, owner ancestry, and named-lane cleanliness as separate exact witnesses with measured envelopes.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not combine network and large-status operations under a shorter parent ceiling; record exact hashes from each completed witness.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the timed-out batch, make no mutation from it, and require all standalone witnesses before fast-forward.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Repository continuity verification only; not scientific or independent-reproduction evidence.
preferred_methods.title: Separated network, ancestry, equality, and cleanliness witnesses

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Map exit 1 to an explicit NO_MATCH witness, keep other nonzero codes as faults, and audit the exact 29 proposal files covering all 290 frozen proposals.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: State no-match semantics explicitly and never let one expected absence suppress later collision categories.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the interrupted batch and rerun the full bounded category set before freezing any proposal.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Search control-flow reliability only; human semantic review remains required.
preferred_methods.title: Explicit no-match normalization for semantic novelty probes
trigger_preconditions: absence is an expected semantic result

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Stop at the privilege refusal, query only executable and command presence without elevation, and record Sandbox unavailable rather than enabling a feature or rebooting.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never elevate or change Windows features for an availability audit; a privilege refusal is a bounded negative, not a retry invitation.
preferred_methods.rollback: Make no host change, retain the refusal, and use the canonical and named repository lanes for bounded tests.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Host capability observation only; not sandbox execution or security assurance.
preferred_methods.title: Non-elevating Windows Sandbox availability audit

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Use an ordered array of explicit replacement pairs with case-sensitive String.Replace, require destination absence before creation, then inspect exact diffs for semantic leftovers.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never use a case-insensitive map when replacement keys differ only by case; separate mechanical copies from semantic apply-patch review.
preferred_methods.rollback: If parsing or inspection fails, retain the negative, remove no history, and do not promote the generated file until exact diff review passes.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Versioned compatibility scaffolding only; semantic correctness still requires explicit review and tests.
preferred_methods.title: Case-sensitive ordered-pair compatibility rewrite

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Use git status --porcelain -uall before staging, direct expected-path existence checks, and git diff --cached --name-only after staging.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: An exact file-set receipt must enumerate leaf paths, not a collapsed directory placeholder.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the inaccurate comparison, make no commit from it, and rerun against uncollapsed or staged leaf paths.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Git file-set enumeration only; content, privacy, and semantic validation remain separate.
preferred_methods.title: Uncollapsed untracked and staged exact-file comparison

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Split existence, status, and content inspection into bounded per-file calls and promote only complete outputs.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not append an unbounded diff-stat walk to the first file-existence witness on a large packet.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the timeout, ignore incomplete aggregate output except its explicit file-existence rows, and rerun bounded checks.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Operational inspection only; it does not validate artifact semantics, privacy, or final integrity.
preferred_methods.title: Bounded per-file inspection after combined status timeout

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Enumerate exact leaf filenames first and read only a returned path.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Treat phase Method Flow storage layout as discoverable state, not an inherited directory convention.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed path assumption and rerun the read against an enumerated leaf path.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Filesystem path discovery only; it does not validate Method Flow content.
preferred_methods.title: Enumerate Method Flow leaf paths before exact reads

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect the known predecessor validator, phase lifecycle receipts, and exact current files directly before expanding search scope.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Start from explicit phase-relative surfaces when the sought lifecycle schema is already localized.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the timeout and narrow the read-only search; expand only if the known surfaces are insufficient.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Search strategy only; it does not validate lifecycle receipt truth.
preferred_methods.title: Known-surface search instead of broad helper scan

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Read the exact source as UTF-8 and apply small semantic regions with independently verified context.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never derive culturally specific patch text from mojibake console output; verify UTF-8 source and keep patch regions bounded.
preferred_methods.rollback: A rejected patch changes no file; retain the negative and reapply only after exact source inspection.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Patch transport and encoding only; wording remains subject to Māori authority and substantive review.
preferred_methods.title: Small UTF-8-exact semantic patch regions

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Set UTF-8 output encoding for the single runner process, rerun summarize, and parse the emitted JSON receipt.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Use process-local UTF-8 when Unicode may reach stdout; never replace or anglicize Māori wording to satisfy a console codec.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed print, leave host settings unchanged, and rerun only the bounded command with UTF-8 output.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Console transport only; it does not confer cultural authority or validate substantive wording.
preferred_methods.title: Process-local UTF-8 for Unicode Method Flow output

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Convert the returned exact leaf listing into an allowlist and read only paths present in it.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Stop before a follow-up read when its leaf is absent from the enumerated allowlist.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the missing-file negative and rerun only the allowlisted exact reads.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Filesystem read selection only; it does not validate artifact content or currency.
preferred_methods.title: Enumerated leaf list as a follow-up read allowlist
